title: Jane Street Real-Time Market Data Forecasting
line: Modeled market behavior with a supervised autoencoder combined with an MLP; ranked 440th of 3,000 participants (top 15%).

title: Spinner Dolphin Photo Grading Protocol
line: Developed a multi-stage model that detects, rates and classifies dolphins by fin distinctiveness, and automated image-data pipelines.

title: BirdCLEF 2024
line: Identified under-studied Indian bird species from call spectrograms using a TensorFlow MobileNetV2 CNN with transfer learning.

title: Higgs Boson Detection 2024
line: Benchmarked multiple scikit-learn models; ranked 11th of 52 on the public leaderboard and 12th of 52 on the private leaderboard.

title: OpenAI CarRacing
line: Developed an AI agent that drives on randomly generated race tracks, with a 2D convolutional neural network built in TensorFlow.

title: Full Cycle TakeOut Web App
line: Created with support from the nonprofit ZeroWaste Oahu and the Full Cycle TakeOut program, in two technology stacks: MERN and Meteor.

title: Protein Folding Algorithm
line: Simulated the hydrophobic-polar (HP) protein folding model with recursive backtracking to find the optimal fold, under sponsorship from Decision Research Corporation.

title: Programming and Algorithms Club (PANDA)
meta: Lecturer and Curriculum Developer · Aug 2022 – Aug 2025
line: Earned the 2023 Best Officer (Big Panda) Award; designed a curriculum tailored to students' programming levels and led small-group lectures on developing and optimizing algorithms.

title: Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) at Mānoa
meta: Server Administrator and Webmaster · Oct 2023 – Oct 2024
line: Maintained and improved the chapter's software and official website using React and Ruby/Jekyll, and built custom applications for chapter leadership on request.
